sources.label: Union excise duties

uses.label: Capital expenditure

union_budget.source: Union Budget, Budget at a Glance (indiabudget.gov.in)
union_budget.note: Gross basis: receipts include the States' share of taxes, which is shown as an outflow. Actuals where published, else Revised or Budget Estimates.

metrics.label: Fiscal deficit
metrics.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Tables 164 and 21
metrics.note: Years are financial years; 2023-24 values are Revised Estimates in the RBI Handbook. Gross fiscal deficit divided by GSDP at current prices.

metrics.label: Revenue deficit (+) / surplus (-)
metrics.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Tables 165 and 21
metrics.note: Years are financial years; 2023-24 values are Revised Estimates in the RBI Handbook. Revenue deficit divided by GSDP at current prices.

metrics.label: Debt (outstanding liabilities)
metrics.source: RBI State Finances: A Study of Budgets 2025-26, Statement 20
metrics.note: Outstanding liabilities at end-March as per cent of GSDP, reported as at the close of the financial year shown.

metrics.label: Interest payments
metrics.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Tables 170, 166 and 165
metrics.note: Years are financial years; 2023-24 values are Revised Estimates in the RBI Handbook. Revenue receipts derived as revenue expenditure minus revenue deficit.

metrics.label: Own tax revenue
metrics.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Tables 168, 166 and 165
metrics.note: Years are financial years; 2023-24 values are Revised Estimates in the RBI Handbook. Revenue receipts derived as revenue expenditure minus revenue deficit.

metrics.label: Central transfers
metrics.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Tables 166, 165, 168 and 169
metrics.note: Years are financial years; 2023-24 values are Revised Estimates in the RBI Handbook. Central transfers = revenue receipts minus own tax and own non-tax revenue (shared taxes plus grants).

metrics.label: Committed expenditure (interest + pensions)
metrics.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Tables 170, 171, 166 and 165
metrics.note: Years are financial years; 2023-24 values are Revised Estimates in the RBI Handbook. Interest payments plus pension payments; salaries are excluded so this is a floor.

metrics.label: Capital outlay
metrics.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Tables 174 and 21
metrics.note: Years are financial years; 2023-24 values are Revised Estimates in the RBI Handbook. Capital outlay divided by GSDP at current prices.

metrics.label: GSDP growth (real)
metrics.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Table 22
metrics.note: Year-on-year growth of GSDP at constant prices (2011-12 base).

metrics.label: GSDP (current prices)
metrics.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Table 21
metrics.note: Gross State Domestic Product at current prices; Handbook reports ₹ lakh, converted to ₹ lakh crore.

metrics.label: Per-capita NSDP
metrics.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Table 19
metrics.note: Net State Domestic Product per person at current prices.

functions.source: RBI State Finances: A Study of Budgets 2025-26, Appendix II (Revenue Expenditure of States and UTs with Legislature)
functions.note: Share of each function in revenue expenditure; 2023-24 are Accounts, 2024-25 Revised Estimates and 2025-26 Budget Estimates. Police is reported under general services.
